name: Multi3WOZ: Multilingual Multi-Domain Wizard-of-Oz Dialogue Benchmark
description: Multi3WOZ is a multilingual, multi-domain, multi-parallel task-oriented dialogue (ToD) benchmark derived from MultiWOZ 2.1, providing culturally adapted dialogues in 4 typologically diverse languages: Arabic, English, French, and Turkish. Each language contains exactly 9,160 multi-parallel dialogues (7,406 train, 877 validation, 877 test; 36,640 dialogues total) spanning over 100,000 dialogue turns across 7 domains (attraction, hotel, restaurant, taxi, train, hospital, police). Dialogues feature turn-level natural language understanding (NLU), dialogue state tracking (DST), natural language generation (NLG), and end-to-end task-oriented modelling annotations.
